events.detail: Observed three open AgentShield findings in the CI security gate; two had no exception records and one exception was expired.
Retrieved the SARIF report, the agentshield-policy/* pack definitions, and the exception register with expiry states.
Proposed two candidates: 'sarif-backed-timeboxed-exception-review' (evidence-backed exception review) and 'blanket-policy-suppression' (disable the policy pack).
Verifier checked SARIF evidence, owner/ticket/scope/expiry fields, expiry enforcement, and the remediation-vs-exception decision; blanket suppression failed all four.
Promoted 'sarif-backed-timeboxed-exception-review'; the expired exception stays rejected until renewed with evidence.
